teams.heading: Tevita Tuiloa launches Fiji Sevens collectable range to honour memorable moments
teams.body: Fiji Rugby and Coca-Cola Europacific Partners have launched a series of limited-edition cans and bottles featuring the men’s Sevens side. The collection celebrates eight specific highlights from the 2025 Hong Kong and Singapore tournaments. At a launch event in Suva, Commercial Director Tevita Tuiloa stated that "Fiji’s rugby story belongs to all of us" as the union looks to inspire young players. The Flying Fijians currently sit bottom of the Nations Championship table following their 17-33 loss to Scotland.

teams.heading: Bundee Aki and Connacht struggle as Glasgow dominate the maul
teams.body: Connacht suffered a 36-19 defeat to Glasgow at Scotstoun in their round three URC fixture on Friday night. The visitors were undone by a clinical Warriors maul, which accounted for four of the hosts' five tries. Bundee Aki’s performance was marked by a late-game outburst, adding frustration to a result that extends Connacht’s winless streak at the venue dating back to 2010. While Josh Ioane twice crossed the line, the damage inflicted by the Glasgow pack proved insurmountable.

teams.heading: Italy prepare for South Africa return to the Allianz Stadium
teams.body: Top-level international rugby returns to Turin as Italy host reigning world champions South Africa at the Allianz Stadium. This fixture represents the Azzurri's first home match of the 2026 Nations Championship. Historically, Italy has reached a best world ranking of No. 8, a feat achieved in 2007 and again in 2024. Following the clash in Turin, the team will continue their November series with fixtures against Argentina and Fiji before the competition concludes at Twickenham.

teams.heading: Wainwright and Reffell shine as Wales stars impress in Premiership victory
teams.body: Aaron Wainwright and Tommy Reffell delivered standout performances in Leicester Tigers’ 38-31 win over Gloucester on Friday, providing a timely boost for Wales ahead of next month's Nations Championship. Wainwright marked his bright start to the season with a try and 14 tackles, while Reffell was lauded as a "nuisance" at the breakdown, producing a vital try-saving tackle. Jac Morgan and Olly Cracknell also featured prominently, with the quartet’s high-intensity displays catching the eye during the tightly contested Slater Cup match.

teams.heading: Mario Ledesma and Shaun Edwards join Felipe Contepomi’s Argentina staff
teams.body: Argentina head coach Felipe Contepomi has confirmed that Mario Ledesma and Shaun Edwards will join his backroom team through to the 2027 World Cup. Ledesma, the former Pumas head coach, returns as forwards coach, while Edwards takes the lead on defence after concluding his consultancy with the Red Roses. Contepomi noted that both men "arrive at Los Pumas with enormous international experience" and will be instrumental in preparing the side for upcoming Nations Championship fixtures against Ireland, Italy, and France.

teams.heading: Les Kiss backs Wallabies to return fire in Sydney rematch
teams.body: Wallabies head coach Les Kiss has urged his side to respond following a heavy 50-19 defeat to the All Blacks at Eden Park. The result marked Australia’s first loss under his tenure, snapping a five-match unbeaten run. Kiss remains confident in his squad's underlying culture despite the setback. "You get a knockback, you find out more about yourself and that’s what we’ll do," said Kiss, who is now prioritising technical adjustments in order to "turn the dial" for next Saturday's clash.

teams.heading: Japan Sakura 7s secure gold medal at 20th Asian Games tournament
teams.body: The Japan Sakura 7s reclaimed the gold medal at the 20th Asian Games held in Aichi and Nagoya, defeating defending champions China 10-5 in a tightly contested final. The victory marks a significant achievement for the squad, who last secured the title two Games ago. While the Japan men’s team missed out on the final after a semifinal defeat to China, they successfully rebounded to claim the bronze medal by defeating Korea 17-5.

teams.heading: New Zealand thrash Australia 50-19 to retain the Bledisloe Cup
teams.body: New Zealand secured the Bledisloe Cup with a comprehensive 50-19 victory over the Wallabies at Eden Park. After a competitive first half, the All Blacks surged away to score five second-half tries, extending their unbeaten streak at the venue to 54 matches. Despite the win, Dave Rennie faces fresh injury concerns: Scott Barrett failed an HIA, Leroy Carter suffered an ankle injury after scoring, and Anton Segner departed with a head wound. Rennie noted, "We just lost key moments in Africa, and we won a lot of those tonight."

teams.heading: All Blacks close gap on Springboks after decisive Bledisloe Cup win
teams.body: New Zealand have narrowed the margin at the top of the World Rugby rankings following their 50-19 victory over Australia at Eden Park. The win added 0.66 points to the All Blacks' tally, moving them to 91.81 and leaving them just over a point behind South Africa, who currently lead the standings with 93.09. With the Nations Championship approaching, New Zealand may challenge for the top spot if they maintain their form during the upcoming November Tests against top-tier opposition.
